title: Approvals
description: Human decisions required before a risky tool action proceeds.
emptyPending: No pending approvals — nothing needs your review right now.

card.reasonPolicy: A published policy rule required approval
card.reasonRiskCeiling: The risk score exceeded this task's ceiling
card.ceilingContext: Final score {score} against this task's ceiling of {ceiling}.
card.paramsIntro: The exact invocation parameters this request is bound to. Credential-shaped values are withheld by key name; this is not full content inspection.
card.paramsTruncated: This payload was too large to show in full. You are looking at an incomplete object.
card.paramsRedacted: {count, plural, one {# value withheld} other {# values withheld}}:
card.digestHint: The exact value an issued grant is bound to. Any change to the parameters produces a different digest and invalidates the grant.

decide.reasonPlaceholder: Add context for the audit trail
decide.outcomeDiffersToast: Someone else's decision took effect first — this request ended up {outcome}, not what you submitted. No double-decision was made.
decide.alreadyDecided: This request was already decided — by another approver, another tab, or it expired — before your decision reached manar-api. No double-decision was made.
decide.timeoutError: Your decision was signaled, but manar-api didn't confirm the final outcome in time. Check this request's status in a moment — it may still have gone through.
decide.pendingNote: The decision endpoint now waits for the approval workflow's real, final outcome before responding — the status above already reflects it by the time this form finishes submitting, no polling needed for your own decision.
